abstract: HL-A (A,B,C, and DR) antigen frequency distribution was determined in 29 patients with choriocarcinoma and in their husbands, as well as in a matched control population of 21 healthy couples. All 29 patients had achieved complete sustained remission with chemotherapy. The HL-A antigen frequency distribution was normal in the choriocarcinoma patients and in their husbands and there was no abnormal HL-A antigen sharing between patients and their husbands. This study does not exclude the possibility that the pathogenesis of resistant choriocarcinoma may be dependent upon tumour-host histocompatibility.
abstract_ja: 29例の絨毛癌患者とその夫、ならびに対応させた健常夫婦21組の対照集団において、HLA(A、B、C、DR)抗原頻度分布を測定した。患者29例はいずれも化学療法により完全かつ持続的な寛解を達成していた。絨毛癌患者およびその夫におけるHLA抗原頻度分布は正常であり、患者と夫の間に異常なHLA抗原の共有は認められなかった。本研究は、難治性絨毛癌の発症機序が腫瘍と宿主の組織適合性に依存する可能性を否定するものではない。
